name: Synthetic Art: Storm of the Sky Saint

sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Lightning Release, Bio Branch

system.description:
In order to cast this jutsu, you must currently have your Synthetic Chakra Mode active and have a creature Grappled by you.

You call out to your synthetic chakra engine, building up the wrath of the storm before calling out to the Raijin. A cylinder of storms surrounds a target creature, before you fill it with lighting causing a plasma like explosion destroying whatever was in your way. The target creature must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d8 lightning and 8d8 wind damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d8 for each damage type.
